question: Which team was the winner of the Vijay Hazare Trophy 2024-25?
solution: The correct answer is __**Karnataka**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Karnataka** emerged as the winner of the **Vijay Hazare Trophy 2024-25**, showcasing an exceptional performance throughout the tournament. • The **Vijay Hazare Trophy** is India’s premier domestic one-day cricket tournament, named after the legendary cricketer **Vijay Hazare**. • Karnataka has a rich history in domestic cricket, and their consistent performances have made them one of the most successful teams in the tournament’s history. • The team demonstrated a blend of strong batting, disciplined bowling, and excellent fielding to secure the championship. • The tournament featured top domestic teams from across India, and Karnataka stood out due to their strategic gameplay and teamwork.
